sourceEvidence.title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer, Vehicle Assembly
sourceEvidence.quote:
Mach Industries is seeking a Lead Manufacturing Engineer to own the Vehicle Assembly system and production launch for our autonomous defense vehicles. You will deliver the factory designs, stations, tooling, conveyance, and automation needed to go from late-stage prototype builds to full-rate production at Mach's Forge factories, at world-class first-pass yield and production rates.

As a technical lead for vehicle assembly, you'll work closely with Build Engineering, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Automation Engineering, Supply Chain, Material Flow, and outside equipment vendors. This is a hands-on technical role with direct reports. You'll shape product designs early, lead builds and production ramps, and mentor a growing team of manufacturing engineers. This role suits an engineer who takes full ownership, solves problems from first principles, and moves quickly without compromising safety or quality.
